scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && (git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,site -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:test: concurrently -n api,site -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:test" "npm --prefix client run dev:test"
scripts.check: cd server && npx tsc && cd ../client && npx tsc -b && npx oxlint && cd .. && vitest run
